description: Starts submissions and spends one of the agency's paid launches; with a sbm_test_ key it spends a test launch and submits nothing. Refuses unless confirm_selected equals the directory count preview_launch returns for the same arguments. With a live key, clients that can ask their user (MCP elicitation) also get a question to confirm, and the answer does not pass through the model.

auto_replace.description: true: within a day the free allowance fills up to 100 with fitting directories, replacing declined ones too. include turns it off unless you send true

confirm_selected.description: The directory count from preview_launch that the user agreed to

directories.description: "auto" (best matches, highest DR first), {include: [ids]} exactly these, or {exclude: [ids]} auto without these

excluded_directories.description: Replaces the project's whole exclusion list for this request; [] clears it. directories: {exclude} leaves some out once instead

name: launch_project
title: Launch a project
